meta.source: 手作業で作成した文脈推測原稿

sentences: Age and infirmity finally forced the violinist to stop performing.
At eighty-four she could no longer hold the instrument for a whole movement.
clues: could no longer hold the instrument for a whole movement
items.reason: 八十四歳で、一楽章のあいだ楽器を支えることもできなくなったと述べられています

sentences: As a lifelong adherent of the theory, he refused to consider alternatives.
He had defended it in print since 1972 and never changed a sentence.

items.reason: 一九七二年から誌上で擁護し、一文も改めなかったと述べられています

sentences: Wild speculation about the merger filled the financial pages for weeks.
Neither company had confirmed anything, and each paper printed a different figure.

items.reason: どちらの会社も確認しておらず、新聞ごとに違う数字が載ったと述べられています

sentences: The young prodigy performed with the national orchestra at eleven.

sentences: The retiring conductor received a warm ovation from the orchestra itself.

He remembered every name, laughed easily, and never seemed tired at six in the evening.

never seemed tired at six in the evening

by March she was looking at other places
items.reason: 六月には完璧だと言っていたのに、三月には別の土地を探していたと述べられています

sentences: Fire destroyed a wide swathe of forest north of the highway.
The burned ground ran for nine kilometers and was two kilometers across.

items.reason: 焼けた土地が九キロ続き、幅も二キロあったと述べられています

sentences: A carved totem stood at the entrance to the coastal village.

asked to stay for two days

reeds grow taller than a person

items.reason: 天井が金で覆われ、八枚の鏡がいずれも四メートルあったと述べられています

continued for eleven months without a change

before the first mass was held

sentences: She consoled the losing team with a short and genuinely kind speech.

at two earlier press conferences that week

each signed a form saying so

items.reason: 四か月食料が門を通らず、井戸も見張られていたと述べられています

sentences: He blanched when the surgeon described the length of the recovery.

the courts will apply the new rule
items.reason: 来月からは効力を持たず、裁判所は新しい規定を用いると述べられています

items.reason: 刷毛で石鹸を立て、白い泡が両頬を覆ったと述べられています

the same group of marks appears only twice
